metadata.case_name: MR TSANG YUNG SANG v. SANFTELD BUILDING CONTRACTORS LTD. AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: comminuted fractures of the right tibia and fibula
source: The first was comminuted fractures of the right tibia and fibula and the second a dislocation laceration of the right big toe.

injuries.description: dislocation laceration of the right big toe
source: The first was comminuted fractures of the right tibia and fibula and the second a dislocation laceration of the right big toe.
injuries.icd_description: Multiple injuries of ankle or foot

injuries.description: an inch shortening of the right leg
source: there is an inch shortening of the right leg.

manifestations.description: almost total loss of dorsiflexion in the right ankle
loss of strength in the calf muscle
toe fixed at an angle of 10 degrees dorsiflexion and about one half its original width
pain from time to time on the construction site causing periodic periods of rest
walking with the aid of two sticks (period after discharge)
reduced carrying capacity (can only manage a barrow half full rather than full)

treatments_received: The dislocation of the toe was reduced
a skin graft applied to compensate for the skin that had been traumatically removed, the donor area being the right thigh
leg treated with plaster; plaster remained in position until 15th May

losses.description: Difficulty negotiating rough and uneven surfaces due to pelvic slant from an inch shortening of the right leg; walking with the aid of two sticks after discharge
Almost total loss of dorsiflexion in the right ankle and loss of strength in the calf muscle leading to reduced carrying capacity
Right big toe fixed at an angle of 10 degrees dorsiflexion and about one half its original width
Now only capable of lighter work, commands a lower rate and is less employable on construction sites

comparable_cases.injury_description: award of $135,000 for pain and suffering (referred to in judgment)
